edit.description: `nested_file_path` stops demanding the host kind's `governs_root`: it composes the host's own unit through the same derivation (`member_projection_path`), so a host that is itself a nested-file member with a directory unit supplies an interior and depth is unbounded. A directory-unit child's template path names its entry file the way a directory kind's glob does, and a template cycle in the declared kind graph refuses loud rather than recursing (invariant 6).

`discover_nested_file` recurses: a nested-file host owning a directory unit is itself scanned for the layers it templates, so a child two layers down is discovered rather than invisible; the declared-governed-path carve-out and the host-identity carry (from the host-keying entry) travel down with it.

`resolve_kind_units`'s nested-file branch (929) is `discover_nested_file`'s one production caller: a recursive walk hands it units whose host is itself a nested-file member, so the host unit it composes each child's id and path from is taken off the unit rather than re-derived from a `governs_root` the deeper host has none of.
`hostUnit` composes a `nested-file`-locus host's unit from its own host rather than refusing every locus but `at`, keeping the SDK's path derivation in agreement with the engine's at depth.

A two-layer corpus: an `area` directory-unit host templating a `page` directory-unit file child, itself templating a leaf child — projections at `<root>/<a>/<b>/<dir>/<key>.<ext>`, addresses `area:<a>/page/<b>/<kind>/<key>`, and a declared template cycle refusing.
`explain` resolves the two-layer address, composing through both hosts.
The frozen-agreement lane gains a two-layer target, so the SDK and engine derivations are gated into agreement at depth, not only at one level.

The cost harness walks `discover_nested_file` per kind (121) and pins glob compilation per distinct glob; a descent per nested layer changes the walk, so the pinned counts and the helper's `(kind, unit.file, unit.host_unit)` read are re-derived against the recursion.

summary: A nested-file member can host a further nested layer: the host's unit composes recursively, so nesting reaches arbitrary depth instead of stopping at one level

tests.asserts: a child two layers down emits at its composed path, carries the two-host-composed address, and a template cycle refuses loud
both derivations agree on a two-layer child's path

acceptance: `cargo test` and `pnpm --dir sdk test` green, with a two-layer corpus emitting, discovering and resolving at both layers, and a self-templating kind refused rather than looping.
notes: Routed from the inbox: note 5 (observed at 022477c4). A multi-segment host name is not the answer — a name is one segment and `/` is the address separator. No new kind fact is needed: a `nested-file` locus already declares `unitShape`, so an intermediate layer owning a directory is expressible today; what refuses is the path composition and the discovery walk. Serialized last: it reshapes the same splice and host-identity surfaces as the four entries before it. scoped at 96c3bdf2
